title: Prime Ministers Salary Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Prime Ministers Salary Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXI OF 2002
PRIME MINISTER'S SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Prime Minister's Salary, Allowances
and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
6th May, 2002]
F.No.2(I)/2002-Pub., dated 6-5-2002.--The following Ordinance made
by the President is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Prime Minister's Salary, Allowances and Privileges (Amendment) Ordinance,
2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once,

ORDINANCE XXI OF 2002
PRIME MINISTER'S SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Prime Minister's Salary, Allowances
and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
6th May, 2002]
F.No.2(I)/2002-Pub., dated 6-5-2002.--The following Ordinance made
by the President is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 3, Act LIX of 1975.--In the Prime
Minister's Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act; 1975, hereinafter referred to
as the said Act in section 3, for the word "twenty-two" the word
"fifty -six" shall be substituted.
